source.title: Owner 2026-10-23: trade the chart's Stacked profile zones (cabatrades 'three profiles, one level') on the first touch

entry.words: if we are below a level and we tap it we short and when we are above and tap it we long, lets try 1:1 and 1,2 x atr stop

taught: [owner 2026-10-23] the levels = the Stacked profile zones: a delta outlier with a TPO single print and a low volume node next to it
[owner 2026-10-23] the delta outlier is measured against its own leg ("a delta outlier from the last leg"), fix both
[owner 2026-10-23] price below a level taps it: short; price above a level taps it: long
[owner 2026-10-23] colour match: long only at a buyers' zone from above, short only at a sellers' zone from below
[owner 2026-10-24] try adding a 6pm vwap filter only long above and short below
not_run: THE DELTA: the tape has no aggressor side; each print's side is the tick rule (up = buy, down = sell), an estimate of the chart's vendor delta.
THE ORDER: a limit at the near edge of the nearest zone above (sell) and below (buy), placed at each 5-minute close, one OCO pair; a limit fills on a one-tick trade-through.
THE STOP: stop_atr x ATR(14) of the 5-minute bars at the moment the order is placed, from the entry price.
PRIOR DAYS IN A SEALED MONTH: their zones are unknown, so the first days of each in-sample block trade fewer levels.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, 4 dollars a round turn, tick replay).
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).

THE LEVELS: the zones of the 5 trade dates before, 4-tick rows, 30-minute TPO letters; a leg = 3+ single-print rows next to each other; outlier 3x the leg's median row; low volume node under 30 % of the busiest row; a zone is used up by its first touch, traded or not.
THE SESSIONS: every Globex pass, 18:00 the evening before to 15:58 ET (eve, asia, london, pre, nyam, mid, pm), flat 15:58; nothing 15:58-18:00.
THE 6PM VWAP: the VWAP of the 1-minute bars from 18:00 ET the evening before (typical price), read at each 5-minute close: above it only the buy orders rest, below it only the sells.
